text: dsh-git-plus 是适用于 DSH 网页客户端的 Git 管理面板。它在会话视图中加入 Git Plus 标签页，并在输入栏显示分支状态；通过 DSH host 服务读取会话工作区并提供 Git 操作。用户可以查看和提交本地变更、浏览提交图和差异、管理分支标签与暂存，并执行 fetch、pull、push 等同步操作。适合在 DSH 网页会话中处理项目版本控制的开发者。需要 DSH 提供 subprocess 服务和会话工作目录；代码未声明额外 API 密钥。

dsh-git-plus adds a Git panel to DSH's web conversation view. Developers can review and commit local changes, browse commit history and diffs, manage branches, tags and stashes, and sync with remotes. It uses the session workspace and DSH subprocess service.
想直接在 DSH 网页里查看和提交工作区的 Git 改动。
能不能在会话页面浏览提交图和每次提交的文件差异？
让 DSH 面板支持切换分支并管理标签和 stash。
我想从网页界面 fetch、pull 或 push 当前项目的代码。
查看历史记录时，希望能按提交信息或哈希搜索。
I want to review and commit working tree changes inside my DSH session.
dsh-git-plus 的功能「查看和提交本地变更」：在会话面板列出已暂存与未暂存文件，支持选择文件、查看差异并提交，也可 amend 现有提交。用户在 Local Changes 视图中操作，输入提交说明后执行。
dsh-git-plus 的功能「浏览提交历史」：All Commits 显示提交图和历史记录，支持按信息或哈希检索，并查看所选提交的详细内容、变更统计与文件差异。用户打开会话面板的历史视图并选择提交即可查看。
dsh-git-plus 在执行 fetch、pull、push 等同步操作时会连接 Git 工作区配置的远程仓库；GitHub 提交头像功能还会请求 api.github.com 获取仓库提交及头像信息。

dsh-git-plus README · dsh-git-plus：
English | [中文](README.zh.md)
An IDE-style Git panel for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI. A sidebar with **Local Changes** and **All Commits**, branch / tag / stash management, fetch / pull / push dialogs, merge with conflict handling, and a zsh-style branch marker in the input bar.
dsh-git-plus README · dsh-git-plus：

dsh-git-plus README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add git+ssh://git@github.com/bitxeno/dsh-git-plus.git
```

Once the package is on npm, the registry form works too:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-git-plus
```

The same command updates an existing installation; append `@<version>` to pin one. Restart `dsh web` after installing (a client-only change just needs a browser refresh).

dsh-git-plus README · Usage：The panel lives in the conversation view as the **Git Plus** tab.

**Sidebar** — top nav switches between *Local Changes* and *All Commits*; beneath it a sync toolbar (fetch / pull / push), then the collapsible *Branches / Tags / Stashes / Remotes* groups:

dsh-git-plus README · Usage：- **Fetch** — pick a remote or fetch all (`--prune` always on).
- **Pull** — pick the remote and remote branch (defaults to the upstream), see the target branch, opt into `--rebase` and `--autostash`.
- **Push** — pick the local branch and the target `remote/branch` (creating a branch on the remote is one select away); tracking reference (`--set-upstream`) shows only for new remote branches, with optional `--tags` and `--force`.
- Branch rows show ahead/behind counts; a greyed icon marks branches with no remote counterpart. Click a branch/tag to filter All Commits, double-click to check it out, right-click for the row menu (checkout, merge, create branch/tag here, copy, delete).
- Both Branches and Remotes fold `/`-separated names into folders, with the default branch first (the local default branch; `origin/main` under Remotes). In Remotes the default branch stays inside its own remote folder and leads it — it is never lifted out of `origin`.
- Stash rows apply / pop / drop (drop arms with a second click).

dsh-git-plus README · Usage：When the panel is narrow — a phone, or a desktop window dragged thin (measured on the panel itself, not the viewport) — the sidebar collapses into a permanent icon rail: the top cell opens the drawer, the next two switch views directly without opening anything, and the four group icons open the drawer already expanded and scrolled to that group. The drawer overlays the content rather than squeezing it; tapping a branch/tag, opening a dialog, tapping the backdrop, or pressing `Esc` closes it.

dsh-git-plus README · Usage：**Local Changes** — stage / unstage / discard per file or in bulk, commit with amend, per-file diffs.

**All Commits** — commit history with a graph rail, search by message or hash prefix, author and time filters, and a commit detail pane: commit body, change stats, per-file diffs (unified or split, image compare, deferred rendering for large diffs), file tree and raw content. Branch / tag / checkout can be launched from any commit row.

dsh-git-plus README · Usage：**Conflicts** — a merge or pull that conflicts returns a banner listing the conflicted files with their resolved state; continue (`git add -A` + commit) or abort from there.

The input bar shows a zsh-style `<repo> (branch)` marker (toggle in Settings; off state moves a status dot beside the Git tab).
dsh-git-plus README · Settings：The plugin detail page has two live options: the input-bar branch marker toggle and the default diff view (unified / split). Saved changes apply immediately.

dsh-git-plus README · Configuration：Host options go into the selected profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: git-plus
  config:
    timeoutMs: 8000
    networkTimeoutMs: 300000

- `timeoutMs` bounds each local git command (default 8000 ms).
- `networkTimeoutMs` bounds network commands — fetch / pull / push (default 300000 ms).
- `maxBytes` caps per-command stdout (default 4 MiB).
- `maxChanges` caps the change list (default 1000).
- `refreshIntervalMs` is the snapshot poll interval (default 30000 ms).
dsh-git-plus README · Configuration：A Host config change needs a `dsh web` restart.

dsh-git-plus README · Development：```sh
npm install
npm run check   # typecheck + unit tests
npm run build   # rebuild lib/ (host + client bundles)
npm run deploy:local  # rsync lib/ into the local dsh profile

`lib/` is committed and is what ships; `deploy:local` deploys it to `~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-git-plus/lib` for local testing.

dsh-git-plus README · Development：Releases: push a `chore(release): bump version to X.Y.Z` commit — the workflow tags `vX.Y.Z`, creates the GitHub release (notes via changelogithub), and publishes to npm when the `NPM_TOKEN` secret is configured.
dsh-git-plus README · Publish to npm (one-time setup)：npm publishing is gated on the `NPM_TOKEN` repository secret — without it the workflow ships GitHub releases only:

dsh-git-plus README · Publish to npm (one-time setup)：1. Create the token: npmjs.com → profile avatar → Access Tokens → Generate New Token. Use **Automation** (classic token) or a **Granular Access Token** scoped to the `dsh-git-plus` package with read and write access. Copy it immediately — it is shown only once.
2. Add it to the repo with the GitHub CLI:
   ```sh
   gh secret set NPM_TOKEN --repo bitxeno/dsh-git-plus
   # paste the token when prompted, then verify:
   gh secret list --repo bitxeno/dsh-git-plus
   ```
3. Ship any release afterwards — the workflow publishes automatically (`latest` dist-tag for stable versions, `next` for prereleases containing `-`).

dsh-git-plus README · Publish to npm (one-time setup)：Notes: the npm package name must be unclaimed (the first publish creates it; validate beforehand with `npm publish --dry-run`). To rotate, regenerate the token on npmjs.com and update the secret value.
